indicator_definition: Primary energy consumption measures the total energy demand of a country, covering consumption of all energy forms before any transformation process. It is expressed in million tonnes of oil equivalent (Mtoe). It includes energy used by the energy sector, distribution losses and final consumption by all sectors.
rationale: Reducing primary energy consumption while maintaining economic output is key to improving energy efficiency and meeting climate targets. Decoupling economic growth from energy consumption is central to sustainable development. Progress means a declining trend in primary energy consumption relative to economic output.
methodology_characteristics: Data are compiled by Eurostat from national energy balances submitted under EU energy statistics regulations (Regulation EC No 1099/2008). Primary energy consumption is calculated using the substitution method for nuclear and renewable electricity. Data are published annually.
